senses.gloss: גַּמֵּי, גַּמַּע ch. = h. to swallow, quaff.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 39:30">Targ. Job XXXIX, 30</cite> <he>גָּמְעָן</he> (Ms. <he>גַּמְעַאן</he>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:7:7">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>שורפה</he>, Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:7">Ab. Zar. II, 7</cite>) <he>גמי לה</he> (ed. <cite ref="C01027"><he>גמילה</he></cite>, corr. acc.) he quaffs it, sucks it out.

<cite ref="Sukkah 49b:5">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>לִיגְמַע גַּמּוּעֵי</he> let him quaff (take full draughts); <cite ref="Sukkah 49b:5">ib.</cite> <he>אגמע גמועי</he> (read: <he>מְגַמַּע</he> with Rashi, or <cite ref="C01059"><he>גַּמַּע</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300).
